description: Compare 2-5 providers side by side using live evidence gathered the same way verify_provider gathers it — identity, payment-readiness, and status evidence for each target, returned as a separate envelope per provider. No composite score is computed and no winner is declared; unknown evidence stays unknown for every target. Free, read-only.

targets.description: Two to five public HTTPS provider, source, MCP, A2A, or API URLs to compare; each is checked through the same live evidence path and returned in its own envelope.

name: compare_providers
title: Compare Providers
